description: A small synthetic company knowledge base (employee handbook, engineering practices, product FAQ) used to evaluate the retrieval and generation pipelines end to end. Queries are hand-crafted to cover single-chunk lookups, multi-chunk answers, cross-document topical discrimination (e.g. two different kinds of "PTO"), a PDF with real (not estimated) page numbers, and one deliberately out-of-corpus question. Extended with 5 additional synthetic fixture documents (security policy, incident response runbook, customer success playbook, enterprise admin console FAQ, compensation & benefits guide) to support a genuinely larger, non-redundant labeled question set — see eval/RESULTS.md for why the corpus was grown rather than padding question count against the original 3 documents.

queries.query: How many days of PTO do full-time employees accrue each year?

relevant_chunks.content_marker: 15 days of paid time off

queries.reference_answer: Full-time employees accrue 15 days of PTO per year, at a rate of 1.25 days per completed month, though accrual doesn't begin until after the 90-day probationary period.

queries.query: Can unused PTO be carried over to the next year, and if so how much?

relevant_chunks.content_marker: carries over into the following year up to a maximum of 5 days

queries.reference_answer: Yes, up to 5 days of unused PTO carry over into the next year; any balance beyond that is forfeited on December 31st unless local law requires otherwise.

queries.query: How many days per week can an employee work remotely without needing special approval?

queries.reference_answer: Up to 3 days per week, as long as the team's core collaboration hours (10 AM to 3 PM) are maintained.
